{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
# This is what pandas.corr() does by default
complete_data = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Check the correlation
correlation = complete_data['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_data['body_mass_g'])
print(f"Correlation: {correlation}")"}
